note: Manual weekly score overrides. Sleeper's current matchup data for these weeks under-counts some teams; the official season standings (roster settings fpts) credit the full points. Builds (build_h2h.py, build_all_time_stats.py, apply_history_overrides.py) replace the matchup score with official_points for the listed roster/week, and give the zeroed starters their real points. An override only applies while Sleeper's matchup score still equals matchup_points, so if Sleeper ever fixes its data the override switches itself off (with a warning).
